changeinfo.changes:
Following features are added or changed:
Particle effects. Game time changed to 180 seconds. Scores of the best player of the match and your local players are always visible during the match. New and exciting visiual and sound indications for killstreaks. Distingtive sounds for each character. Kicked bombs don't explode instantly when they stop moving. HUD icons of teams in team deathmatch have been changed. Camera shakes after every bomb explosion. Characters have been slightly enlarged. No friendly fire for team deathmatch. In team deathmatch danger zones of placed bombs are now in color of your team.
